nphi.title: Building Stronger Public Health Institutions and Systems (BIS), Phase 2
nphi.summary: Norad-funded programme to strengthen public health institutes in four core partner countries, with selected BIS-1 activities continuing in Uganda and Ghana. Themes are climate and health, digital health, infectious diseases, NCDs and…

nphi.title: ICMR/DHR regional dialogue on strengthening health research systems
nphi.with: National health research bodies of Bhutan, Nepal, Sri Lanka and Timor-Leste
nphi.summary: ICMR offered ethics forms and free training to partners and agreed regular exchanges and joint capacity building on AMR, NCDs, One Health and field epidemiology.

nphi.title: BIS collaboration in Nepal
nphi.with: Kathmandu University School of Medical Sciences; CAIPHEN consortium; Nepal Health Research Council; Planetary Health Research Centre; Tribhuvan University; National Public Health Laboratory; Ministry of Health and Population
nphi.summary: Supports evidence-informed policy, implementation research fellowships, public health education and NGS/bioinformatics training. Also includes planetary health courses and a climate–dengue case study.

nphi.title: CAPTURA – Capturing data on AMR patterns and trends in use in regions of Asia
nphi.with: CAPTURA consortium; Fleming Fund (UK aid); national AMR surveillance sites
nphi.summary: Fleming Fund regional grant, run from IVI's platform since 2019, that gathers historical AMR and antimicrobial-use data and trains national teams on prescribing surveys, WHONET analysis and surveillance monitoring.

nphi.title: UK Public Health Rapid Support Team (UK-PHRST)
nphi.with: Deployments bilaterally and through WHO GOARN; academic partners LSHTM, Oxford, King's College London
nphi.type: Outbreak response & research partnership (case study article)
nphi.summary: A PHE–academic team that deploys within 48 hours to outbreaks in low- and middle-income countries and also does research and capacity building. Deployments included cholera in Ethiopia, the 2017 Freetown mudslides, plague in Madagascar,…

nphi.title: IANPHI Asia Regional Network
nphi.with: Public Health Institute of Mongolia (vice chair); IEDCR Bangladesh; School of Public Health and Community Medicine Nepal; National Institute of Public Health Japan; National Centre for Disease Control India; National Health Laboratory Myanmar
nphi.summary: Regional network of Asian NPHIs launched in 2016 with China CDC as chair and eight founding members, modelled on the IANPHI Africa network to foster cooperation among Asian institutes; it now counts 28 NPHIs.

nphi.title: ICMR – Nepal Health Research Council MoU
nphi.summary: MoU between ICMR and the Nepal Health Research Council on health research collaboration.

nphi.title: Fleming Fund Country Grant for Nepal
nphi.with: National Public Health Laboratory (NPHL); Central Veterinary Laboratory; AMR Containment Multisectoral Steering Committee; WHO; FAO
nphi.summary: FHI 360 implemented the Fleming Fund country grant in Nepal, building AMR/AMU surveillance capacity in human and animal health together with the National Public Health Laboratory and Central Veterinary Laboratory.

nphi.title: NCGM–Tribhuvan University Institute of Medicine MoU
nphi.summary: An MoU signed in 2013 for collaborative research and human resource development.

nphi.title: Regional Field Epidemiology Training Programme for South-East Asia at NCDC India
nphi.actor: National Centre for Disease Control (NCDC), India
nphi.summary: NCDC, a WHO collaborating centre for epidemiology and training, runs a regional field epidemiology course for health staff from WHO South-East Asia Region countries.

nphi.title: Dengue and climate change case study, Nepal
nphi.summary: NIPH supported NHRC in producing an in-depth case study of how climate change shapes dengue in Nepal.
